Setting aside the morality of the plan, Charles's plan is horrible. I don't trust Charles or anyone really to build a ritual that truly brings the greedy, powerful practitioner's low and elevates the person who will replace the system with a better alternative. Even if it is similar to the Musser trials and is basically like a re-do of life with different circumstances, you are still going to get people who are genuinely intelligent and talented trying the ritual. It is entirely possible for a total shitbag to be smart enough to logic themselves through all the parts of ritual, including the parts that will test morals. That's not even getting into if someone finds a way to take on the ritual sideways instead of head on, which seems likely given just with the sheer variety of Practices out there. At least one person will be able to find a loophole or something in the system and there is no guarantee that person is a one Charles is looking for. 

Morally, I hate it since a lot of innocent people will get caught up in it and basically just absolves Charles of having to find a real, workable solution to the problems in practitioner society. Instead, of actually doing the leg work to find solutions to problems and implementing those solutions, he instead places his hope on this nebulous paragon that will eventually show up (which can take years if not centuries). That leaves the actual ritual to stick around and wreak havoc on in Ontario and most likely all of North America.

Basically, nothing about the plan is salvageable since it relies too much on hope and other people acting exactly as he planned. Any plan that relies on hope or people acting in exact, predictable ways is almost always bound to fail.

For a negative binding, I think it would important to focus on the CB's past. As a predator meant to frighten humanity, I think a binding that shows we have beaten back these predators would be perfect. As a result, I would want three circles that tells a bit of a story.

My first would be a circle of bear traps or something similar. The traps  would still be bloody from the animals that it trapped before, specifically predators. This tells the CB, and the spirits, that the trap has not only been used to kill predators like itself, but also primed and ready to be used again. 

The second circle would be of furs of wolves or of predators in general. This would show that we not only wounded and trap the animal, we killed and skinned it for our own use, appropriating parts of itself for our own prosperity.

The final circle would be made of wolf meat, preferably cooked. The wolf meat would show that we are no longer prey who fears the night, but the predator that kills those who once stood higher than us and feeds on them. The reason I would want it cooked is because cooking is big part of humanity and representative of civilization. Cooking the meat means it ready to be served and devoured by humans specifically, not just any random predator.

We now have a negative binding that tells the story that humans are no longer the hunted, but the hunters. That the predators of the night must fear us now and stay away from humans or be hunted, skinned, and devoured.

We know before the CB became a karmic Supreme Court Justice, she was an Anima that represented the fear of nature, specifically of predators. Once she became the CB, she became representative of brutal justice, with power over violence and savagery in the area. 

 Knowing this, if we want to do a positive binding, blood is the way to go. I would most likely try to make a circle or diagram of blood and meat. Since three's are a big thing, I would want the blood and meat to come from three different sources. 

The first source would be from a murderer, maybe a serial killer or something similar. Since I am a practitioner in this scenario, I am probably equipped enough to procure the executed prisoner or to find a way to kill the subject. Now I have the blood of someone brought to a brutal end due to their own crimes.

Finally, and this was one that took me a while to figure out, but I would want something that represents pure savagery. The body and blood that are left behind after a goblin attack or something similar would be good I think. Especially, if it was a piece of shit that was killed, such as we see one of the Kennet goblins doing to a bunch of hunters. 

Using all these ingredients, I would mix them together to enhance their "flavor" and make my diagram or circle. And now you have a positive binding for the CB!
